qRCode.$description: QRCode's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--qr-code-<name>) on the page, a container or one QRCode, and every QRCode inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

dark.$description: The dark modules: black in every theme, since scanners need the contrast. A brand color works only if it keeps about 4.5:1 on light.

light.$description: The light modules and the quiet zone: white in every theme, dark mode included (most scanners can't read a light-on-dark code).

status-bg.$description: Behind a status, where the faded code shows through.

status-text.$description: A status message over the faded code (4.5:1).

radius.$description: The corners, kept small: the quiet zone is part of the code.

size-sm.$description: size="sm", quiet zone included (96px): a code beside text, for a short URL.

size-lg.$description: size="lg" (240px): a payment code to scan from across a counter, or a long value.

faded.$description: How much of the code shows behind a status: a trace, so the message reads 4.5:1 over it.
